name: ags-config
description: AGS (Aylur's GTK Shell) configuration for Hyprland

scripts.start: bash -c 'source scripts/runtime-artifacts.sh; publish_runtime_artifacts source-host || { printf "%s\n" "$RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_ERROR" >&2; exit 1; }; trap cleanup_runtime_artifacts EXIT; ags run config-bundled.tsx'
scripts.dev: bash -c 'source scripts/runtime-artifacts.sh; publish_runtime_artifacts source-host || { printf "%s\n" "$RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_ERROR" >&2; exit 1; }; trap cleanup_runtime_artifacts EXIT; ags run config-bundled.tsx'
scripts.test:gjs: bash -c 'source scripts/runtime-artifacts.sh; configure_runtime_artifacts source-host || { printf "%s\n" "$RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_ERROR" >&2; exit 1; }; trap cleanup_runtime_artifacts EXIT; ags run --gtk 4 scripts/tests/gjs/run.ts'
scripts.quality: pnpm lint:lines && pnpm lint:styles && fallow --only dead-code --regression-baseline .fallow-regression-baseline.json --fail-on-regression
